hook: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon ranks number one on a new AI index.
sections: It is a frontier model released first to cyber defenders.
Think of the best sniffer dog in the country. Because it is so good at finding hidden threats, it goes to airport security first, before anyone else can borrow it.
First, a subset of cyber defenders use it to find software flaws. Second, access widens to trusted partners, then developers and consumers.
Before, frontier models launched to everyone.
Now it scores 59 on the index and 88.2 percent on SEC-bench Pro.
Introductory price is 2 dollars per million input tokens. Alphabet is the exposure; no wider date is given. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
